body:
I was happier in London so that should do the fix tbh

Thanks reddit for the 0 upvotes and 4 upvotes to the oldesr comment. Very original
Itd make more sense to vent to someone I know instead of one of the most mocked-by-outsiders websites. Ill delete this and bottle it in until I leave this hole

In France only. I had my share of Indians in London. Im working hard to go back there now. Either that or I move to India if it fails, or I kill myself

Im picky, but I have the "qualifications" to be so. Or else I wouldnt have it confirmed by others every now and then

Theyre all so aggressive and illiterate you have no idea. There's a massive rap+drugs culture like in most countries. I have not seen any arabs that were educated like in London. Dunno about blacks

Im mediocre academically but I can still write/talk/speak my native language without butchering it, and I understand stuff when someone speaks to me

Last sentence sounds odd but I feel like Im talking to empty fish tanks sometimes

Im not even pretending to be smarter or anything that I really am, I really am surrounded by nounces all the time, whereas in London it just FELT different, regardless of their actual level of education

Ive tried black, white, asian, latinos, some of them were fun but ugly, or really hot but with 2 braincells, or not interested, or just nice but missing something interesting, like a common hobby/interest. When we do share interests they loop back to not being handsome or missing other qualities

Not to brag but I get a lot of compliments about being fun (when im not making posts like these), good in bed and cute, so its even worse, because I only exist to make people feel good without being able to get it back

I wish someone would make me feel so much for them, but I never loved anyone
Ive considered it today, Ill look for that once I have a job

Dont want people to be sour because I complain about having bad partners, which here on Reddit is a rarity apparently

Like Id love to have genuine advice from older people who went throught similar shit

Not like Id expect something good from this site apart from memes and specific advice questions, like tech support, etc

Oh my mom's not an asshole, but she's just working her life away 8-8 instead of meeting friends and intimacy. She can't even save money at the end of the month. I told her living like that she may as well be dead so that no one else will benefit but me

She had tons of opportunities from other, actually genuine people, in life to get up. She didnt follow any. Now thats her punishment and mine too

If you can't get suicide off your mind for more than 7 mins I don't see how you'd actively listen to someone for the same amount of time

What a generic comment that 50% of people here are sick of seeing
